# Repository presentation assets

- `skills-demo.gif`: README hero, 1280 × 640, seven synchronized before/after frames at 10 FPS, repeating indefinitely.
- `social-preview.png`: still image for GitHub Social Preview, 1280 × 640 and below 1 MB.

These assets reuse the GAM robot-knight demonstration with a Skills-specific title and six skill cards. Both animation panels preserve the source frame transform and use the complete source height. The image demonstrates GAM processing output; the skills provide workflow guidance, client control, and Godot export.

The social preview must be uploaded separately in repository **Settings → General → Social preview → Edit → Upload an image**. Committing the PNG does not apply the repository setting.
